intro: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!
description:
2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens puts an enchanting spin on the classic 2048 puzzle formula! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers and launch devastating attacks against a coven of woodland foes. Fight your way through alluring sirens, spell-weaving forest witches, and majestic fae queens—each wielding wild nature magic and a flair for the dramatic.

Strategically smash high-value tiles into your foes to deal damage and disrupt their sylvan spells. Each enemy brings unique abilities to the battle: some ensnare your tiles in thorns, others drain your power, and a few can twist the grid with tangling roots. With five difficulty levels, the challenge adapts to your skill.

Once you've tamed the wildwood, take on Infinite Mode for a pure puzzle experience. Combine tiles, stack up high numbers, and see how long you can flourish in the ever-growing forest. 

Will you master the wilds and become the ultimate puzzle champion?
